Calculate Simpipe Simulated DEG Ratio and True DEG Recovery (Approach 1)

Source: R/05_metrics_de_signal.R
calc_simpipe_deg_ratio.Rd

Evaluates the ability of simulation methods to simulate Differentially Expressed Genes (DEGs) according to the Simpipe benchmarking framework (Duo et al., Genome Biology 2024). Uses edgeRQLFDetRate on reference data as ground truth, and compares candidate DEGs returned by the simulation method.

Usage

calc_simpipe_deg_ratio(
  ref_data,
  sim_data,
  ref_celltypes,
  sim_celltypes,
  sim_degs = NULL,
  fdr_cutoff = 0.05,
  logfc_cutoff = 0,
  min_cells = 5
)

Arguments

ref_data

Reference count matrix (genes x cells).

sim_data

Simulated count matrix (genes x cells).

ref_celltypes

Factor or character vector of reference cell groups.

sim_celltypes

Factor or character vector of simulated cell groups.

sim_degs

Optional list of character vectors containing candidate DEGs already returned by the simulation method for each pairwise group contrast. If NULL, edgeRQLFDetRate is executed on sim_data to detect candidate DEGs.

fdr_cutoff

FDR threshold for true and candidate DEGs (default 0.05).

logfc_cutoff

Absolute log2 fold change threshold (default 0).

min_cells

Minimum number of cells per group to perform DE (default 5).

Value

A list containing:

P

Overall weighted Simpipe true DEG recovery proportion (P)

deg_ratio

Overall ratio of candidate/simulated DEGs to true DEGs (N_given / N_true)

pairwise_results

Data frame with per-pair details: Group1, Group2, N_true, N_given, N_overlap, P_true, DEG_ratio, Weight

true_degs

Named list of true DEG gene vectors per pair

candidate_degs

Named list of candidate/simulated DEG gene vectors per pair

Details

For 2 groups (\(n = 2\)): $$P = P_{\text{true}}$$ For 3 or more groups (\(n > 2\)): $$P = \sum_{i=1}^M P_{\text{true}, i} \cdot \frac{N_{\text{given}, i}}{N_{\text{given}}}$$ where \(P_{\text{true}, i}\) is the proportion of true DEGs identified from two cell groups through edgeRQLFDetRate, \(N_{\text{given}, i}\) denotes the DEG number returned by the simulation method from the \(i\)-th group pair, and \(N_{\text{given}}\) denotes the total DEG number across all group pairs.

Also calculates the candidate-to-true DEG ratio: $$\text{DEG Ratio} = \frac{N_{\text{given}}}{N_{\text{true}}}$$

Examples

data(example_scrna, package = "scSimEval")
res <- calc_simpipe_deg_ratio(
  ref_data = example_scrna$ref,
  sim_data = example_scrna$sim,
  ref_celltypes = example_scrna$cell_types,
  sim_celltypes = example_scrna$cell_types
)
#> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes
#> calcNormFactors has been renamed to normLibSizes
res$P
#> [1] 0
res$deg_ratio
#> [1] 0
